pages.title: Captain of a Living Deck
pages.text: Saddle a cleaned Hullback, add plank armor and actually steer it with the Helm.

pages.title: Captain of a Living Deck
pages.text: Two barnacle variants provide marine decoration for the berth and sandwiches supply another controlled voyage.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find Hullbacks in deep oceans and clean their gunk with axe and shears. Then use the native saddle, plank-armor and Helm interactions. Mounting alone is not steering.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find a Hullback in deep oceans and clean its gunk with an axe and shears. The friendly creature becomes indebted to its helper.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Saddle a cleaned Hullback, armor it with planks and control it using a Helm. The creature becomes a controllable ship-like mount.
